Pranav S: Kickoff — Novacare POC. Need to lock use-case scope, success criteria, timeline, and answers for their security questionnaire. Meeting w/ customer tomorrow 9am PT.
Emily K: Suggested core use cases: 1) Clinical note summarization (structured outputs + key findings) 2) Patient triage suggestions (routing + urgency score) 3) Embedding-based chart search (fast recall). Prioritize 1+2 for MVP. :white_check_mark:
Maya G: Budget question — Novacare asks for hosted pricing + option for Dedicated if latency matters. Can we give a rough number for 10k reqs/day? Need to include embedding costs.
Alex R: Ballpark: hosted with batching should be fine for POC; p95 < 600ms on our Curie-like profile for summarization if we cap seq len. Dedicated estimate ~ $Xk/mo for reserved capacity (will confirm).
Emily K: Success criteria proposal:
- Functional: summarize -> entity accuracy >= 88% on provided test set; triage -> F1 >= 0.8 for high-urgency.
- Perf: p95 latency <= 600ms for RPCs; throughput >= 20 reqs/s.
- Ops: no data exfil events; SLO 99% during 2-week run.
Pranav S: Also need eval prompt templates + golden set from Novacare (50 examples min). Emily, can you draft prompts?
Emily K: Yep. Draft prompts + evaluation rubric by EOD today. I'll include examples for hallucination checks and structured JSON output.
sec-bot: Security checklist flagged: HIPAA required, data residency US-only, customer-managed KMS requested. Also ask: do we need BAA for POC or only for production?
Maya G: Customer asked if POC requires BAA. They prefer to sign before ingesting PHI. Sales wants a mitigation: pseudonymize data for POC unless BAA signed.
Alex R: Technical note: we can enable on-the-fly token anonymization on our side. For embeddings/search we'll need to strip identifiers. Implementation ETA 3 days if we do it.
Emily K: Minimal POC endpoints for Sprint 1 (proposed):
```
POST /summarize_note  -> {patient_id:null, text}
POST /triage_suggest -> {text} -> {urgency_score, disposition}
POST /chart_search   -> {query} -> [embedding_ids]
```
Keep responses in strict JSON schema to ease evals.
Pranav S: Timeline draft: Week0 (setup + data prep), Week1 (baseline model + prompts), Week2 (eval + tuning + customer review). Two-week POC total.
Jordan (Sales): I'll confirm customer's readiness for pseudonymized dataset. Also pushing to get signed DPA/BAA — if delayed, recommend scope only synthetic/pseudonymized examples.
Maya G: Pricing ask again — Jordan, can you get them to commit to a small hosted spend ($2k) to cover token usage? We can credit back if they go enterprise.
Jordan (Sales): Will try. Also need a short statement for procurement: "Novacare POC — hosted usage, US-only data, pseudonymized PHI unless BAA in place." Will send to procurement.
Alex R: One engineering blocker: triage model needs a latency-optimized quantized variant. Ops: need GPU burst for peak evals. Tagging infra team after we confirm load.
Pranav S: Action items:
- Emily: prompts + eval rubric (due today)
- Alex: feasibility + cost estimate for Dedicated + GPU burst (due tomorrow)
- Jordan: procurement + BAA status, hosted spend confirmation (due tomorrow)
- Maya: finalize pricing fallback plan (due tomorrow)
- sec-bot: send checklist link + required questionnaire fields to Jordan

Emily K: I'll drop the prompt examples in this thread: short/medium/long templates + golden set template.
Jordan (Sales): Thanks everyone — bringing this to Novacare tomorrow. Will post meeting notes and follow-ups here. :rocket:
sec-bot: Reminder: attach the security questionnaire PDF link https://redwood-inference.internal/sec/questionnaires/novacare-poc.pdf
Pranav S: Great. Let's sync post-meeting. :thumbsup:
